title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Cherry Crush Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Cherry Crush Nic Salt delivers the classic taste of ripe Cherry with supporting notes of Blueberry, Raspberry and Strawberry. The result is a rich and full-bodied vape with a dark berry sweetness and soft fruity undertones. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths for fast, smooth nicotine delivery. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
